content: अपरिग्रह {%a.%} Without possessions or belongings, attendants <ab>&c.</ab>; Without a wife; तदाप्रभृत्येव विमुक्तसङ्गः पतिः पशूनामपरिग्रहोऽभूत <ls>Ku. 1. 53</ls> quite destitute, as in निराशीरपरिग्रहः <ls>Bg. 6. 10</ls>. .{@-हः@} .²1 Non-acceptance, rejection, renunciation, one of the several kinds of {%yamas%} (mental restraints) stated in Yogaśāstra by Patañjali. .²2 Destitution, poverty.
